portalSubjectRef.title: Portal account
portalSubjectRef.description: The portal account this player signed up with. Set once by the portal.
portalSubjectRef.x-notes: portaliq's subject reference, stamped by its writer on the createPlayerProfile action (players-self-signup). Not a uuid, so no format. readOnly: OpenRegister refuses a change on update and allows the stamp on create.

selfRegistered.title: Signed up through the portal
selfRegistered.description: This player made their own profile through the portal.
selfRegistered.x-notes: Set by PortalProfileListener on a portal create, never by a client.

awaitingReview.title: Awaiting review
awaitingReview.description: A game master has not yet looked at this new player.
awaitingReview.x-notes: Set true on a portal create by PortalProfileListener; a game master clears it with Mark reviewed on the New players page. OpenRegister has no 'is empty' filter, so the list filters on this flag rather than on a missing reviewedAt.

reviewedAt.title: Reviewed on
reviewedAt.description: When a game master reviewed this new player.

reviewedBy.title: Reviewed by
reviewedBy.description: The game master who reviewed this new player.
reviewedBy.x-notes: A Nextcloud user id, stamped by PlayerReviewListener. Plain string: OpenRegister has no user format.
